_what_this_is: One record per SIMULATED person. Demonstration data for the Explorer; not a research result.
_provenance: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — simulated by scripts/make_synthetic_demo_data.py. Not derived from, fitted to or copied from any participant. It describes no real person.
_anonymisation: Not applicable: these records are simulated and describe no one.

_definitions.autocorrelation: Lag-1 correlation of the person's own simulated reports.
_definitions.predictability_band: well-predictable: r >= 0.5; near-unpredictable: r < 0.2; otherwise typical
_definitions.band_source: Fixed thresholds chosen for this demonstration.
_definitions.variability_sd: Standard deviation of the simulated reports.
_definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean F1 over the five stress levels, on this person's scored simulated reports. 'Twin' here is an illustrative stand-in (a rounded exponentially weighted mean), not the research model.
_definitions.warm_up: The first K reports, used as history and not scored.

_uncertainty: No interval is shown: these are simulated records, and no inference about any population can be drawn from them.
_redistribution: No participant-level research record is distributed with this application. These records are simulated.
illustrative_rule: the scored simulated people at the minimum, median and maximum autocorrelation
